source: 785 Performance
target: 785 Praestatio

source: Seeing the assassin who had been hiding suddenly sit openly on a chair by the window, calmly watching him as if he didn’t care about the ongoing battle, Admiral Deep Sea, Howl Constantine, felt a sudden heavy weight in his heart.
target: Videntes sicarium, qui antea latens versabatur, repente aperte in sella iuxta fenestram sedere et eum tranquille spectare, quasi de proelio continuo nihil curaret, admiralis Profundi Maris, Howl Constantine, subitaneum grave pondus in corde sensit.

source: Such a posture and expression suggested that the opponent didn’t consider him a threat and was absolutely confident in dealing with him.
target: Talibus habitibus et vultu insigne ostendebat hostem eum non minacem putare atque omnino fidere se posse adversus eum agere.

source: That’s why he didn’t attack immediately to support his companions but instead sat there, arrogantly smiling and observing.
target: Ideo non statim impetum tulit ut socios adiuvaret, sed potius illuc sedebat, superbe subridens et attentus omnibus rebus.

source: Without any hesitation, Howl Constantine instinctively aimed his obsidian trident at Lumian.
target: Sine ulla mora, Howl Constantine instinctu tridentem suum obsidianum in Lumian direxit.

source: A bolt of silver-white lightning formed in his hand, amplified by the trident’s tip, and shot out like a raging thunder serpent towards Lumian.
target: Fulmen argenteo-album in manu eius formatum, in vertice tridenti confirmatum, velut furiantis tonitrui serpens ad Lumian iaculatum est.

source: Lumian kept his right foot on his left knee, his face bearing a mocking smile as if Howl Constantine’s desperate counterattack was just child’s play, incapable of changing the outcome at all.
target: Lumian pedem dextrum in genu sinistro reposuit, facie subridens, quasi confutatio desperata Howl Constantine esset solum ludus puerilis, qui omnino eventum mutare non posset.

source: Of course, this was just a front he put on.
target: Certe, hoc solum simulacrum fuit quod ostentavit.

source: In reality, he couldn’t attack Howl Constantine or leave the hundred‐meter range, or else the Fate Exchange would be interrupted.
target: Revera, non poterat Howl Constantine oppugnare nec spatium centum metrorum relinquere, alioquin Fatum Commutatio interrumpi velle videbatur.

source: But not being able to attack didn’t mean he couldn’t influence the current battle.
target: Sed quod oppugnare non poterat, non significabat se in proelio praesenti influere non posse.

source: Lumian left his shadow form and deliberately revealed his presence to Howl Constantine, using himself as bait to attract most of Admiral Deep Sea’s attention and create a sense of pressure and fear, forcing him to react hastily and increase the chance of making mistakes.
target: Lumian umbraticam formam reliquit et conscio animo praesentiam suam palam Howl Constantine revelavit, se ipsam uti praeda ad maiorem attentionem Admiralis Profundi Maris alliciendam atque sensum pressurae et timoris creando, eum impellens ut festinanter responderet et occasionem errorum augeret.

source: Even a Hunter who couldn’t strike, speak, or communicate could still provoke, scheme, and set traps!
target: Etiam Venator, qui non poterat ferire, loqui aut communicare, adhuc provocare, machinari et laquearia insidiari poterat!

source: The thick silver-white thunder serpent struck Lumian.
target: Serpens tonitrui crassus argenteo-albus Lumian percussit.

source: With a crack, Lumian’s figure shattered like a mirror, leaving only the quickly charred wooden chair behind in the ravaging lightning.
target: Cum crepitu, figura Lumiani quasi speculum fracta est, solam celeriter combustam sellam ligneam in fulmine vastante relinquens.

source: He disappeared again, and the thunder serpent, constrained by the chair’s material, didn’t dissipate much.
target: Iterum evanuit, et serpens tonitrui, materiae sellae coartatus, non multum evanuit.

source: This made Howl Constantine anxious, considering whether to break through the window and dive into the sea.
target: Hoc Howl Constantine anxium fecit, dum meditatus est utrum fenestram frangeret et in mare mergi vellet.

source: Underwater, he feared no Beyonder below demigod level!
target: Sub aqua, nullum Beyonder infra gradum semideus timebat!

source: Even many Saints couldn’t dive into the depths to fight him!
target: Etiam multi Sancti in profundum mergi ad eum pugnandum non poterant!

source: Just then, he felt his limbs and body being bound layer by layer, making it difficult to move or turn the obsidian trident quickly.
target: Mox sensit membra et corpus suum strato post stratum vincta esse, quod movere aut celeriter tridentem obsidianum convertere difficile faciebat.

source: The bindings tightened rapidly.
target: Vincula celeriter stringebantur.

source: Taking advantage of Lumian drawing away most of Howl Constantine’s attention and caution, Franca had set up the spider silk of a Demoness of Pleasure, entangling Admiral Deep Sea layer by layer.
target: Ex commoditate quod Lumian magnam partem attentionis et cautelae Howl Constantini abstulit, Franca filum araneum daemonissae Voluptatis posuit, quo Admiralis Profundi Maris strato post stratum implicabatur.

source: Faced with this restricted situation, Howl Constantine stopped and let the translucent octopus on his face glow with dawn-like brilliance.
target: Ob hanc condicionem restrictam, Howl Constantine sistit et permisit polypode translucenti in facie sua quasi aurorae splendore fulgere.

source: The light suddenly exploded into countless fragments, sweeping through the captain’s cabin like a storm.
target: Lumen repente in innumerabilia fragmenta dispersum est, per cellam capitanei quasi tempestas transvolans.

source: The long table with food shattered into pieces, the metal walls were marked with deep scratches, and Franca and Jenna’s figures shattered into countless mirror fragments again, while the invisible spider silk broke inch by inch, unable to restrain Howl Constantine any longer.
target: Mensa longa cum cibo in partes dirupta est, parietes metallici scalpitibus profundis notabantur, et figurae Francae atque Jennae iterum in innumerabilia fragmenta speculi dirutae sunt, dum filum araneum invisibile ex unius unci passu frangebatur, iam Howl Constantinem tenere non posse.

source: In the corridor, away from the captain’s cabin door, Anthony was unaffected by the light storm, as was Lumian outlined beside him.
target: In corridorio, procul a porta cellae capitanei, Antonius a luce tempestatis non affectus erat, sicut et Lumian, qui iuxta eum delineatus apparuit.

source: Lumian placed his hand on the metal sliding door of the staircase, using his contractual ability.
target: Lumian manum posuit super ianuam metallicam labilem scalae, facultate sua contractuali utendo.

source: He enclosed the area within the Bottle of Fiction, with the entry and exit condition being female.
target: Inclusit aream intra “Bottle of Fiction”, cum conditione introitu et egressus esse femina.

source: This effectively blocked any rescue attempts by the pirates, preventing interference in their battle.
target: Hoc efficaciter conatus salutis a piratis interclusit, interpositionem in eorum proelio prohibens.

source: Except for teams with female captains, most pirate ships had very few female Beyonders, if any at all.
target: Nisi turmas cum gubernatricibus feminis, plerae naves piraticae valde paucas feminas Beyonder habebant, si quidem habebant.

source: The non-Beyonder women on board were merely ship prostitutes, incapable of becoming regular pirates.
target: Feminae, quae non erant Beyonder, in nave tantum meretrices navales erant, neque possunt ordinarii piratae fieri.

source: Outside the Carnival Bar.
target: Extra Taberna Carnivalis.

source: The real pirates, the disguised Mason, and the rest simultaneously noticed that the glass windows no longer reflected the scene of Great Shark Jörg and the others fighting the unknown adventurer.
target: Piratae veri, Mason dissimulatus, et reliqui simul animadverterunt fenestras vitreas iam non repraesentare scaenam Magni Squalo Jörg et aliorum cum ignoto adventore pugnantium.

source: The glass appeared dim, showing the bar’s interior with no bartender or customers.
target: Vitrum obscurum videbatur, ostendens interiora tabernae sine poculatoribus aut clientibus.

source: “What happened?” a pirate asked loudly, uncertainly.
target: «Quid accidit?» inquit pirata alte et incertus.

source: “What ability was used?” Similar questions echoed.
target: «Quae facultas adhibita est?» quaestiones similiter resonabant.

source: They all suspected the unknown adventurer was behind the changes, as Great Shark and his crew wouldn’t hide their fight; they would want to showcase their strength to more pirates.
target: Omnes suspicabant ignotum adventorem mutationum auctor esse, quia Magni Squalo et turma eius pugnam suam non ocultabant, sed virtutem suam pluribus piratis ostendere vellent.

source: Within the Bottle of Fiction.
target: Intra Vas Ficti.

source: Great Shark Jörg, wearing black gloves, was surrounded by signs of explosions and charred marks.
target: Magnus Squalo Jörg, manicas nigras gerens, erat circumdatus signis explosionum et vestigiis combustis.

source: He had timely distorted the unknown adventurer’s attack intent, avoiding injury in the recent bombardment.
target: Tempestive impetum ignoti adventoris consilium distorsit, ita ut in recente bombardamento laesus non esset.

source: However, his companion, Ship Destroyer, another Beyonder of the Hunter pathway, had long been unconscious from a combination of Beyonder powers and explosion damage.
target: Attamen comes eius, Navis Exstinctor, alius Beyonder per semitam Venatoris, diu ex mixtura virium Beyonder et damnis explosionis in statu inconscientiae versabatur.

source: The other pirates were also scattered, none unscathed.
target: Ceteri piratae quoque dispersi erant, nemo intactus.

source: Gazing at the unknown black-haired, blue-eyed adventurer several meters away, Great Shark Jörg cursed the teleportation ability.
target: Intuens ignotum adventorem, qui capillis nigris et oculis caeruleis, nonnullis metris distante esset, Magnus Squalo Jörg virtutem teleportationis maledixit.

source: Just as he was about to shift positions and attempt a Bribe, the handsome adventurer’s figure rapidly faded like a projection and disappeared.
target: Modo cum locum mutare et “Bribe” conari pararet, figura venustissimi adventoris quasi imago celeriter evanuit et evanita est.

source: Worried it was another teleportation, Great Shark Jörg dove to the side, turning to look behind him.
target: Timens ne altera teleportatio esset, Magnus Squalo Jörg ad latus delapsus est, et se convertens ut post se spectaret.

source: Nothing happened.
target: Nihil evenit.

source: Jörg and the remaining pirates, suspicious and tense, maneuvered cautiously multiple times, but the adventurer never reappeared.
target: Jörg et ceteri piratae, suspicaces et anxii, pluries caute moverunt, sed adventor numquam redivit.

source: Finally, the bald Great Shark began to grasp the situation.
target: Denique, calvus Magnus Squalo, rem comprehendere coepit.

source: That was just an illusion?
target: Numquid hoc solum illusio fuit?

source: We fought an illusion and nearly lost?
target: Illusionem pugnavimus et prope perdidimus?

source: Where did the real one go?
target: Quo abiit verus?

source: Realizing this, Great Shark Jörg blurted out, “Sh*t! The Newins!”
target: Hoc intellegens, Magnus Squalo Jörg subito exclamavit: “Stercus! Newini!”

source: The unknown adventurer’s real target was the Newins and the Admiral!
target: Verus destinatus ignoti adventoris Newini et Admiralis erat!

source: Jörg and the others grew anxious but were trapped in the Bottle of Fiction, unable to get out.
target: Jörg et ceteri anxii facti sunt, sed in Vas Ficti inclusi, exire non poterant.

source: After trying several methods and abilities without success, they resorted to violent disassembly.
target: Postquam varias rationes et virtutes sine successu temptaverunt, ad dissectionem violentam confugere decreverunt.

source: Aboard the Newins.
target: In nave Newins.

source: As the light storm began to subside, Jenna quickly appeared behind Admiral Deep Sea, in a blind spot created by his own body.
target: Dum tempestas lucis coepit subsidere, Jenna celeriter apparuit post Admiralem Profundi Maris, in angulo caeco a corpore ipsius creato.

source: Then, using all her strength, she stabbed a dagger covered in silent black flames into Howl Constantine’s back.
target: Tum, omni vi utendo, pugionem silentibus nigris flammis opertum in tergo Howl Constantini confodit.

source: Although he couldn’t turn or redirect the trident in time, Howl Constantine remained unfazed.
target: Etsi tridentem convertere aut tempore opportuno dirigere non potuit, Howl Constantine impassibilis mansit.

source: From his cloak emerged a silver-white lightning bolt that struck Jenna at a speed too fast to dodge.
target: Ex pallio eius emersit fulmen argenteo-album, quod Jenna ictu adeo celeri percussit ut evadere nequeat.

source: Countless tiny electric serpents coursed over Jenna’s body, but she seemed largely unharmed and only slightly slowed.
target: Innumerabiles parvuli serpentuli electricae per corpora Jennae percurrebant, sed illa vix laesa et parum retardata videbatur.

source: Pfft!
target: Pfft!

source: The dagger covered in black flames pierced Howl Constantine’s black cloak.
target: Pugio, nigris flammis opertus, pallium nigrum Howl Constantini perforavit.

source: At the beginning of the fight, Jenna had thrown a Louis d’or at Howl Constantine, not to seek luck but to activate the Decency brooch, completing a Bribe that significantly weakened his attacks, defenses, and controls against her for a while!
target: In initio pugnae, Jenna “Louis d’or” in Howl Constantinem iecit, non qua fortunam peteret sed fibulam “Decency” activandam, complens Bribe, quae impetum, defensionem et moderationem eius contra eam per aliquod tempus signanter debilitavit!

source: Since then, neither the rampaging lightning nor the light storm had affected her as much as she let on.
target: Ex tunc, nec tonitrus saevitus nec tempestas lucis eam quantum affecerat, ut ipsa patefecit.

source: Her frantic dodging and use of the Mirror Substitution were meant to psychologically deceive Admiral Deep Sea!
target: Fugam impetuosam et usum speculi substitutionis ad fallendum psychologice Admiralem Profundi Maris destinabantur!

source: She didn’t expect Howl Constantine to be unaware of the Bribe ability, given that his deputy was likely a Briber.
target: Non exspectabat Howl Constantinem se facultate “Bribe” nescire, cum eius vicarius probabiliter “Briber” esset.

source: Instead, she performed as if the Bribe had failed, leading him to attribute the Louis d’or toss to another ability.
target: Contra, se gessit quasi “Bribe” defecerit, inducens eum ut iactum “Louis d’or” ad aliam facultatem attribueret.

source: At the start, Howl Constantine might still have guarded against the Bribe, but in the heat of battle, and with time running short, he instinctively responded without caution.
target: In initio, Howl Constantine fortasse contra “Bribe” vigiliam habuit, sed in ardore pugnae et cum tempus deficeret, instinctu sine cautela respondit.

source: Thus, he ignored the Bribe from before and didn’t stop Jenna’s assassination!
target: Itaque, Bribe priorem neglexit et caedem Jennae non sistere permisit!

source: With a pfft, the black-flamed dagger pierced Howl Constantine’s cloak and flesh.
target: Cum “pfft”, pugio, nigris flammis opertus, pallium et carnem Howl Constantini perforavit.

source: Acting was for a better assassination!
target: Agere erat ad meliorem caedem obtinendam!

source: After the successful strike, Jenna felt a strong resistance and wriggling flesh as if alive, preventing further progress with the dagger despite her full strength.
target: Post ictum felicem, Jenna sensit validam repulsionem atque carnem contorquens quasi animata, quae ulteriorem pugionis progressum impediebat, quamquam omni vi sua utebatur.

source: She abandoned force, instead channeling the black flames into Howl Constantine’s body.
target: Virtutem reliquit, potius flammis nigris in corpus Howl Constantini infundens.

source: As the black flames surged, Admiral Deep Sea howled in pain.
target: Dum flammae nigrae increabant, Admiralis Profundi Maris dolore ululavit.

source: Franca seized the opportunity to reach Howl Constantine’s side, stabbing the transparent Wintry Blade into Admiral Deep Sea.
target: Franca occasionem arripuit ut ad latus Howl Constantini perveniret, et “Wintry Blade” transparentem in Admiralem Profundi Maris confodens.

source: The Wintry Blade pierced the skin and flesh but couldn’t go deeper into Howl Constantine’s body.
target: “Wintry Blade” cutem atque carnem penetravit, sed in corpus Howl Constantini profundius penetrare non potuit.

source: But it was enough.
target: Sed id sufficiebat.

source: Howl Constantine’s body stiffened as if frozen, and his thoughts became sluggish.
target: Corpus Howl Constantini riguit quasi congelatum, et cogitationes eius tardari coeperunt.

source: Franca slid to Jenna’s side, retracting the Wintry Blade.
target: Franca ad latus Jennae labitur, retrahens “Wintry Blade.”

source: Simultaneously, she flipped out a compact mirror with her left hand, reflecting Howl Constantine’s body.
target: Simul, manu sinistra speculum compactum extulit, quod corpus Howl Constantini reflexit.

source: Then, with her right hand, she smeared black flames on the mirror’s surface.
target: Tum, manu dextro, flammās nigrās in superficiem speculi diffudit.

source: Demoness’ curse!
target: Maledictio daemonissae!

source: Black flames erupted from Howl Constantine’s body, burning it but not touching the octopus on his face.
target: Flammae nigrae ex corpore Howl Constantini erupērunt, eum comburentes, sed polypum in facie eius non tetigerunt.

source: Howl Constantine let out a pained shriek, breaking free from the stiffness and mental fog, slamming the obsidian trident onto the metal floor.
target: Howl Constantine gemitum dolorosum edidit, rigiditate et caligine mentis evadens, tridentem obsidianum in solum metallicum contundens.

source: Blinding lightning burst forth.
target: Fulmen caecum erupit.
